ST. MICHAEL'S CHURCH 225 JEROME STREET BROOKLYN 7, N.Y. August 30, 1945
Miss Doris Panyard Muskegon, Michigan
Dear Miss Panyard:
God bless you and yours. Many thanks for your favor of Aug. 25 just noted. I hope things smooth off amicably between the two families. If you have opportunity, try and stress " ... Blessed are the Peace-makers for they shall be called the child- ren of God" .... Who is a more practical peace-maker than he who overlooks short-comings of a neighbor. - Please God the Enroll- ments will the Poor Souls will help. Thank God they hardly ever fail.
I had quite a talk with Rae Garland and a number of others from Detroit this p.m. - long distance. All seem well and hope- ful. Thanks be to God.
We had a fine retreat up near Garrison on the Hudson last week in the Monastery of the Immaculate Conception.
Hoping that you keep well and with best wishes - God's blessing to all I beg to remain
Sincerely yours in Christ. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
P.S. pray that I get some system whereby to catchup with my correspondence.
Praised be Jesus!
